description: Small operation smoke matrix for Windows prebuilt package CI. These operations are intentionally conservative: they should execute through the public standalone API, preserve expected prims, export a temporary output layer, and reopen that output layer successfully.

classification_legend.analysis_only: Reads or reports scene data without intended stage edits.
classification_legend.safe_default: Uses operation defaults that are expected to be safe on generic USD assets.
classification_legend.safe_with_params: Uses explicit conservative parameters to avoid destructive behavior.
classification_legend.mesh_only_or_noop: Affects mesh prims when present and should no-op on non-mesh assets.
classification_legend.material_aware: May inspect material bindings or material-driven data.
classification_legend.time_sample_only_or_noop: Affects authored time samples when present and should no-op on static assets.
classification_legend.requires_output_reopen: Must export and reopen a temporary output layer to catch composition or serialization failures.

operations.name: print_stats
operations.description: Read-only stats collection. Verifies hidden diagnostic operations execute through the packaged runtime.

operations.name: compute_extents
operations.description: Authors mesh extents where applicable. Safe on non-mesh assets and useful after geometry-changing operations.

operations.name: optimize_primvars_index_simplify
operations.description: Indexes duplicate primvar values and simplifies uniform primvars without removing material-bound data.

operations.name: optimize_time_samples_lossless
operations.description: Runs time-sample cleanup in strict lossless mode. Static assets should no-op; animated assets should only remove exactly redundant samples.

operations.name: remove_unused_uvs_block
operations.description: Detects unused UV primvars but authors block opinions instead of permanently removing attributes.

operations.name: generate_normals_standard
operations.description: Generates or fixes mesh normals with the standard 60-degree sharpness angle while preserving prim topology.
